streams.label: Performance PM (5:30pm) — POLP back squat, then WOD at 60–70%
streams.text:
A. POLP Back Squat (3s x 10r x 65% in week 1, +5% for every successful week).

B. 12 min AMRAP:
12 Power Cleans
12 Toes to Bar
9 Hang Squat Cleans
9 Chest to Bar Pull Ups
6 Thrusters
6 Bar Muscle Ups
Barbell 60/42.5 kg

(Summary of the gym blog post; the Competitors PDF wasn't posted this week. Full text: https://www.crossfitclaremont.com.au/post/monday-16-11-2026)

→ A is your POLP back squat (wk9 row): builds 116 × 5, 132 × 3, then 149 × 3 × 5. B at 60–70%: WL is straight after.

streams.label: Weightlifting PM (6:30pm) — wk 6/9 heavy
streams.text:
Week 6/9 of the Cycle

(0 - 20 min)
A. Snatch: Build to a 2RM

(20 - 30 min)
B. Snatch Balance:
2 x 70%, 75%, 80%, 85%

(30 - 45 min)
C. POLP Back Squat:
*First week 3s x 10r x 65%, add 5% for every successful week. If you fail the 10s twice chat to a coach.

*If you did the Squats in class or have time after:
4 x 5 Band Assissted Natural Leg Extensions
+
3 x 1 min banded march

→ Back squat was done in class, so do the accessory instead: band-assisted leg extensions 4 × 5 + banded march 3 × 1 min. Snatch 2RM: last week's best was 78, so let the warm-ups decide.

streams.label: Performance AM (5:30am)
streams.text:
A. 4 rounds:
4 min AMRAP:
6 Wall Walk Complex (1 wall walk + 1 wall-facing HSPU)
12 Hanging DB Box Step Ups (20", 22.5/15 kg)
Max Cal Row in the remaining time
*3 min cap on the wall walks + step ups
Rest 1 min between rounds
*Mod: 6 wall walks + 6 banded WFHSPU

(Summary of the gym blog post; the Competitors PDF wasn't posted this week. Full text: https://www.crossfitclaremont.com.au/post/tuesday-17-11-2026)

→ The wall-facing HSPU here is this week's HSPU work: smooth and strict, stop short of grinding. Row at a strong, repeatable effort, not all-out.

*First week 10r x 55%, 60%, 65%, add 5% to each lift for every successful week. If you fail the 10s twice chat to a coach.

streams.label: LSKD Long Hard Night (8pm – 8am)
streams.text:
Overnight erg relay, team of 3: one person working at all times, ~4 h of work each across row, ski, bike and run stations.

→ Pace each shift at an effort you can repeat all night: first shifts HR under 152, settle into it. Eat and drink every break as you rehearsed. Warm layers between shifts.
